name: blueprint/debug-loop
description: The 4-phase root-cause loop: reproduce (rh_run), gather evidence (store), hypothesize (extract the symptom facts), fix, verify (rh_run again). Every phase leaves a receipt - understand before fixing.
ingredients: rh_run to reproduce and verify (exit codes verbatim)
rh_text_extract symptom facts { symptom, trigger, error }
recipe: reproduce: rh_run the failing command, capture exit + tail -> evidence: store the exact output -> hypothesize: extract { symptom, trigger, error } from the evidence -> fix -> verify: rerun until green -> every phase a receipt, the fix summary stored on the record
result_kind: one receipt per phase + the fix summary on the bug record
cost_hint: one extract per hypothesis; runs free
pitfalls: the failing tail is the evidence - never truncate it away
one hypothesis per fix; receipts show which one worked
verify with the SAME command that reproduced
exit codes are verbatim - do not reword the failure
